changes.title: Find recorded topics by typing
changes.text: The Ask a Question screen gains an offline topic search across registered recorded subjects and public field labels. Choosing a result opens the existing question builder with a count, breakdown or total to refine. It does not use AI or search player values.

changes.title: Protect UIMSD search and data accuracy
changes.text: Four new tests cover public-only indexing, hidden-column exclusion, accent and case folding, and correct question handoff. Retained deterministic large-cache and query tests guard earlier work without altering scores, saves or raw records.

changes.title: Retain verification and complete history
changes.text: The previous private TEST275 compiled APK and its complete verified records are preserved. UIMSD reliability, stress verification and audit receipts remain distinct from this candidate; no earlier delivery or physical test is implied.

commentary: Private source candidate following successful core-only run 39086294891: 1,802 core tests, 355 XML suites, four UimsdTopicSearchTest tests, zero failures/errors/skips. Require a completely new private debug APK gate using actual immediately previous compiled TEST275 producer source 909286ed86788d462f853fd47b9632cefac96691 / run 39076194628, same signing/application ID, complete Git path comparison, all 38 API34 tests and at least 57 required screenshots.
